# GadgetJudge

> GadgetJudge is an independent developer's portfolio of thoughtfully crafted Android apps and games. The apps are designed to be easy to use and focused on what you need to do.

The app pages below explain each app and show screenshots. Use the official Google Play listings to check current availability, device compatibility, and purchase information.

## Website

- [GadgetJudge](https://gadgetjudge.com/): The official app portfolio.
- [App Support](https://gadgetjudge.com/support/): Contact the developer for help, bug reports, and suggestions; restore Remove Ads in Simplest Shopping List on iPhone or iPad.

## Apps

- [Simplest Shopping List](https://gadgetjudge.com/simplest-shopping-list/): A grocery list app with quantities, notes, frequently bought items, light and dark themes, list sharing, and backup and restore. No account is required. Sharing sends a copy of the items; it is not live shared-list synchronization.
- [Simplest Reminder](https://gadgetjudge.com/simplest-reminder/): An Android reminder app with one-time and recurring schedules, quick and custom snoozing, reminder search, light and dark themes, and backup and restore. Reminder delivery depends on the relevant Android permissions and device settings.
- [Pulse Pilot](https://gadgetjudge.com/pulse-pilot/): A one-touch Android arcade game. Place energy pulses to steer the pilot through moving gates, collect power-ups, and build a perfect chain.
